blendVariants.label: Natural
blendVariants.title: Exquisitos Natural
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Cedar, toasted nuts, coffee, light pepper and caramel sweetness lead a compact, wrapper-forward profile. The Ecuadorian sun-grown leaf brings more spice and dry wood than a shade-wrapped cigar, while the Dominican core keeps the smoke rounded and steady. At 33 ring the wrapper stays prominent, with a concentrated cedar-and-coffee finish rather than the darker cocoa weight of the Maduro.
blendVariants.priceNote: Cigar Hut exact Natural page lists the single at A$21 and also offers 10 cigarillos. The 50-count box is excluded by the catalogue purchase cap.
